identityLaw.productCoordinates: Use existing elementRef/pathwayRef/controlRef/stateRef when source already owns one.
identityLaw.sourceCoordinates: When no standalone ref exists, use the exact source symbol/type path (for example VexLifeVisionFamily.Effect.EngageScope or VexLifeModelsFamily.State) rather than inventing an alias ID.
identityLaw.relationshipRows: Represent semantic law as tuples/rows over source coordinates: Family + current State + Control -> Act(admitted State?, Effect?) -> realization/observation -> successor State/Projection.
identityLaw.crossOwnerRows: Represent cross-owner relationships by their exact from/to source coordinates plus relationship kind and evidence; do not mint an independently authored relationship identity merely to draw an edge.
identityLaw.journeyIdentity: Journey IDs are allowed because a journey is a distinct path across multiple Product coordinates, not another identity for a feature.
identityLaw.workIdentity: VexWork work/project refs remain VexWork identities and do not become Product feature identities.

Keep a meaningful correction and have it lawfully available to the next relevant Vex turn.

Import a supported model, acquire/use it, prove a turn, restart, remove/redownload/forget without collapsing those controls.
